BiblicalUsage: This is the word for dust — the fine, light particles that rise and settle. It becomes ‘small dust’ over Egypt and breaks out in boils; and the blossom of the proud ‘shall go up as dust’ in Isaiah.
TheologicalSignificance: Dust is what man was made from and what pride returns to, and in both verses it comes as judgment — a reminder that what looks solid, God can reduce to dust.
